text:
Applications open for Community Service Organization grants and event sponsorships in Valdez
M. S. Booth
Local nonprofit organizations in Valdez can now apply for the Community Service Organization Grant Program and the Community Service Organization Event Sponsorship/Support, according to a July 22 announcement from the city.
The application deadline for the Community Service Organization Grant is August 17 at 5:00 p.m. Nonprofits interested in hosting community events may also be eligible for city sponsorship or support, with applications due by August 15 at 5:00 p.m.
Information and application forms for both programs are available online. The grant program is intended to assist local nonprofits in carrying out their missions, while the event sponsorship/support opportunity provides additional resources to help organizations host community events.
The city encourages all eligible local nonprofits to consider applying before the respective deadlines. More details about each program, including eligibility requirements and submission instructions, can be found on the city's website.
